reason: I already have an Instagram agent I've used before and he delivers, slowly, but he delivers. Paying the item price up front to a brand new name I've never heard of, after what happened to my cousin, is not something I do in the first month.
objection: They still want the item money and their fee before anything ships. If this page disappears like the one that took my cousin's deposit, that money is gone and I have no one to chase.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing their real office in Baghdad with my own eyes, or a friend I trust telling me they got their order on time, then I'd try one small cheap item first.
